scientific_integrity: The integral Morse attaching-degree matrix is computed as exact integer gradient paths from the standalone program; the full face-poset acyclicity is checked, and a separate mod-two chain computation corroborates the homology.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral homotopy classification for the single truncated-tetrahedral graph at higher-independence cutoff two. It does not extend to other polyhedra, equivariant representations, or arbitrary cutoffs; independently audited priority and external validation are not claimed.
title: Mixed-dimensional integral homotopy of the truncated-tetrahedral two-independence complex
